svg.title: Dual-view video question answering with option-conditioned evidence
svg.desc: Real frames from EgoLongQA video e4947cad50181471 illustrate global and option-conditioned views. A shared VLM answers each view. Matching answers are accepted; otherwise per-view option probabilities are normalized, averaged, and maximized. Diverging dotted lines expand the option-conditioned view into retrieval, temporal context, and chronological packing. The displayed question is a faithful shortening of the annotation; the four options are unchanged. Displayed frame subsequences are illustrative and do not claim to be a recorded model selection or prediction. The example answer C, red, is taken from the dataset annotation.
svg.metadata: Implementation revision 376b1c0. Image provenance: assets/bird_apple/provenance.json. Dataset imagery is embedded; all text, film borders, arrows and other diagram elements remain editable vectors.
